Re-enter the password to allow sensitive actions for 5 minutes

post.summary: End the current session and clear the cookie

get.summary: 204 when the cookie holds a valid session (used by the proxy for the static docs)
Latest sign-in events, newest first
Every active account with its roles, masked client id and which broker secrets are set (never their values)

post.summary: Register a Dhan account (client id, write-only API key and secret, identity, roles and their settings); needs step-up

get.summary: One account with all settings (client id masked; secrets only as set / not set)

delete.summary: Remove an account (archive: history and audit trail are kept); needs step-up

put.summary: Change name, client id, colour and notes; needs step-up
Replace the Dhan API key and/or secret (write-only; omitted values stay) and the key's issue date; needs step-up
Switch roles on or off and set the Data kind (primary or standby); needs step-up

put.summary: Replace the trading configuration (mode, risk profile, capital, styles, instruments, overrides); needs step-up

Save the portfolio settings (default bucket, include in totals, auto refresh off or daily at a time, first import date). When the account is connected, has the Portfolio role and has no holdings, every holding Dhan lists is imported in the same request, dated with the first import date (optional firstImport.rows override dates per key); the settings are saved even when the import fails (import.status failed, import.errorCode portfolio.import_failed). Answer: {account, import} (import always present)

post.summary: Start the Dhan consent sign-in (at most 25 a day): returns the Dhan login page to open in the same tab; Dhan returns to /api/brokers/dhan/callback within 10 minutes; needs step-up

delete.summary: Disconnect: delete the stored access token (local only; Dhan tokens end at their expiry); nothing to do when not connected; needs step-up

get.summary: Audit entries of the account, newest first
The redirect URL to register with the Dhan app: {public base URL}/api/brokers/dhan/callback
Dhan's redirect after the consent login (?tokenId=…): exchanges it for a token and redirects (302) to /accounts?account={id}&connected=1 or &connectError={code}
All risk profiles with the number of accounts that use each

post.summary: Create a risk profile; needs step-up

put.summary: Replace the name and values of a risk profile; needs step-up

delete.summary: Delete a risk profile; refused (409) while an account uses it and for the built-in profiles; needs step-up

get.summary: Buckets to choose from: custom buckets and the default bucket of each account with the Portfolio role

post.summary: Add a custom portfolio bucket

get.summary: Search the master list: q (symbol, name, ISIN), type, sector, fno, asmGsm, series, tracked (true|false), includeRetired, sort, page, pageSize (max 100)
Counts of the active instruments by type, series, F&O and ASM/GSM, and of the active shares by sector (incl. Unclassified), for the filters; plus how many are tracked
One instrument with all fields and its broker ids

post.summary: Track 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing; a retired one that is not tracked yet is refused with 400 instruments.retired)

delete.summary: Untrack 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing; their history is kept and tracking again continues from it)

post.summary: Look up pasted tickers, canonical symbols or ISINs (up to 5,000, case-insensitive): matched instruments and the unmatched entries (never guessed)
Refresh the master list from Dhan in the background (force: true skips the unchanged-file check); 409 instruments.refresh_running while one runs

get.summary: The refresh in progress (phase, rows read), the last finished one, the daily schedule and the number of active instruments
The most recent refreshes, newest first (take 1 to 100, default 20)

The baskets with their member counts: the system baskets first (kind portfolio: one per portfolio bucket, read-only, by account then name), then the owner's in their order (kind manual); archived manual ones only with includeArchived=true

post.summary: Create an empty basket (name, colour, purpose, description); 409 baskets.name_taken when an active basket has the name (ignoring case)

put.summary: Put the baskets in this order: the ids must be every active basket exactly once (400 baskets.invalid), 409 baskets.conflict when baskets changed meanwhile

post.summary: Copy or move up to 500 instruments from one basket to another, atomically and idempotently (only members of the source are transferred; targets are tracked automatically); a system basket can be the source of a copy only, anything else with one is 409 baskets.system

put.summary: Replace the name, colour, purpose and description of a basket that is not archived; 409 baskets.system for a system basket

delete.summary: Archive a basket (idempotent): it leaves the list, its members and history stay readable, instruments stay tracked; 409 baskets.system for a system basket

get.summary: The members of a basket in their order, with the instrument and its tracked block; asOf=yyyy-MM-dd (India date) gives the members at the end of that day. A system basket gives the instruments of the bucket's current holdings with quantity and accountName; asOf on it is 400 baskets.invalid

post.summary: Add 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing); untracked ones are tracked in the same transaction, a retired one that is not tracked is refused (instruments.retired)

delete.summary: Remove 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing); the stay stays in the history, the instruments stay tracked

put.summary: Put the members in this order: the instrumentIds must be every member exactly once (400 baskets.invalid), 409 baskets.conflict when the basket changed meanwhile

get.summary: The newest additions and removals of a basket, newest first (take 1 to 1000, default 200); 400 baskets.invalid for a system basket
The baskets (not archived) that hold the instrument now

Holdings with lots summary, profit/loss, XIRR and day change: accountId, bucketId, status (open default, closed, all), q (symbol, name, ISIN), sort (symbol, name, qty, avgCost, lastPrice, invested, value, pnl, pnlPct, xirr, dayChange, dayChangePct, acquiredOn, bucket, account; prefix - for descending; rows without a value last), page, pageSize (max 100), groupBy (account, bucket, sector, basket) with groupKey (account id, bucket id, sector name, basket id, or ~none for Unclassified / No basket) to list one group's holdings; an unknown key gives an empty page. With groupBy and no accountId only accounts that count in totals are listed (includeInTotals), like the groups and the summary, while the list without groupBy includes the others too. Each row has previousClose, dayChange (rupees), dayChangePct (percent), priceAt and priceSource (sync or quote)

Totals of the holdings of an account or bucket (all accounts that count in totals when neither is given): invested, value, P&L, XIRR, day change (dayChange, dayChangePct, dayChangeExcluded: open holdings left out for lack of a previous close), counts, lots on the default date, pricesAsOf (oldest and newest price time), last sync

The holdings grouped by account, bucket, sector or basket (by): per group holdings, unpriced, invested, value, P&L (rupees and percent), realised, XIRR (from the union of the group's cash flows) and xirrState, day change, dayChangeExcluded and weightPct (share of the scope's total value), plus the scope total; additive is false for baskets (a holding is in every live basket that holds it, or in No basket; groups overlap). Filters: accountId, bucketId, status (open default, closed, all), q; sort (value, invested, pnl, pnlPct, xirr, dayChange, name; prefix - for descending; default largest value first; groups without a value last; at most 200 groups). stackBy (account when by=sector, sector when by=account) adds parts[{key, name, value}] to each group. Group keys: account id, bucket id, sector name, basket id, ~none for Unclassified / No basket (a master sector spelled ~none counts as Unclassified). Without accountId only accounts that count in totals (includeInTotals) are in the groups, the total and the children, unlike the flat holdings list which includes the others; an unknown accountId gives 200 with no groups (not 404 as for the summary); more than 200 groups are cut off without a flag, the total still covers the whole scope. A group of only unpriced holdings, and a total of only unpriced holdings, have null value, pnl, pnlPct, xirr and xirrState no_price (the summary shows value 0)
The lots of a holding with the profit/loss and XIRR of each

put.summary: Set the acquisition date of a lot (1990-01-01 to today); the lot stops using the default date. A lot rebuilt from trades (source trade) takes its date from the trade: 409 portfolio.lot_from_trade; the opening lot of such a holding must stay before the earliest trade: 400 portfolio.invalid, field acquiredOn

post.summary: Fetch the account's holdings from Dhan for the first import in the portfolio settings, saving nothing; defaultDate (and each row's suggestedDate) is the account's first import date, 2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another

Sync now: bring the holdings in line with Dhan (an account without holdings is imported instead, every holding dated with its first import date and the run recorded as an import; new holdings dated today, quantity changes as lots, sales closed first-in first-out); optional body {confirm, expectedOpenHoldings, expectedWouldClose}; 409 portfolio.sync_running while a sync runs; 409 portfolio.confirmation_required (listedHoldings, openHoldings, wouldClose) when Dhan's answer would close all or most holdings, unless confirm is true with the numbers echoed back; 409 portfolio.confirmation_stale when the answer differs from the confirmed numbers

get.summary: The account's refresh settings (mode, daily time, first import date, hasHoldings), the next scheduled run and the latest sync run

Value history of the lots of a scope (accountId, bucketId; all accounts that count in totals when neither is given) from the lots and the stored day bars adjusted for splits and bonuses: points {date, value, invested, benchmarkValue (the same cash flows in the benchmark index, null when unavailable), nav, benchmarkNav} (NAV starts at 100 and ignores cash flows), coverage {holdings, covered, unpriced, lateStart}, partial, benchmark {state ok|unavailable, instrumentId, symbol, name, tracked, hasBars, reason}, maxDrawdown and benchmarkMaxDrawdown {pct, from, to} (a fall of pct %), firstDate, lastPriceAt (set when the last point is today's live one) and resolution. from/to yyyy-MM-dd; resolution day|week|month (last trading day of the period; default the finest with at most 2,000 points, 400 portfolio.invalid when a given one gives more). An unknown account or bucket gives an empty history

The benchmark index the portfolio is compared with (Nifty 50 until another is chosen): instrumentId, symbol, name, isDefault, tracked, hasBars; all null when the instrument master has no such index yet

put.summary: Choose the benchmark index: body {instrumentId} of any index of the instrument master that is still listed; 400 portfolio.invalid for no id, an unknown id, a non-index or a retired index. Audited; the cached histories are dropped

post.summary: Track my holdings: tracks the instruments of the open holdings of the scope (accountId, bucketId) that are in the instrument master, with the bulk tracking command; idempotent. Answers how many were added, how many holdings are not in the master (notInMaster) and how many instruments are retired and skipped; starts no job, the hint says the next Update data builds the bars

Track the benchmark: tracks the benchmark index with the bulk tracking command; idempotent. Answers how many were added; starts no job, the hint says the next Update data builds the bars. 404 portfolio.not_found when the instrument master has no benchmark index

get.summary: The CSV folder (files loaded and pending), the Dhan Data account and whether a fetch can run, the aggregates per timeframe, the stored bars with the last bar (last tick) and how many trading days (by the trading calendar) it is behind, the job in progress, the last job of each phase, the next holiday, how many calendar days await confirmation, the gaps in the bars (open, unfillable, filled), the scheduled end-of-day run (enabled, time, next run, last automatic run) and pendingCorporateActions (suggested splits or bonus issues waiting for a decision)

The tracked instruments and the ones with bars, with first bar, last bar, 1-minute bars, source (csv|dhan|mixed), status (current|behind|empty) and the open gaps: q, status, hasGaps (true keeps instruments with open gaps), sort (symbol|name|firstBar|lastBar|bars, '-' for descending), page, pageSize (max 200)

The latest bars of an instrument, newest first: timeframe 1m|5m|10m|15m|30m|1h|1D|1W|1M (default 1D), take 1 to 1000 (default 100), adjusted (default false = raw prices; true adjusts prices and volume for the applied corporate actions on read — each bar by the factor of its India date, a week or month bar by the first day of its bucket — and adds the adjustment block: applied, factor, actions)

post.summary: Start a data update in the background: steps (any of csv, dhan, aggregate, quality; default csv, dhan and aggregate, always in that order; quality checks the data after the others, see /data/quality), forceCsv loads unchanged CSV files again, refetchGaps also retries the sessions the Dhan phase gave up on (unfillable), csvFiles (1 to 214 file names of the CSV folder, only with the csv step; see /data/csv/files) loads only those files - an empty list or a name the folder does not have is 400 data.invalid naming it. 202 with the job; 409 data.job_running while one runs, 409 data.master_missing without an instrument list

get.summary: The most recent data updates, newest first (take 1 to 100, default 20)
The sessions of tracked instruments with missing 1-minute bars (ADR 0017 §3), newest first: status (open|filled|unfillable), instrumentId, page, pageSize (max 200)

What the owner should know about the data for the notification bell: sessions with missing bars (data_gaps_open), instruments failing the data quality checks (data_quality_failed), suggested corporate actions to review (data_corporate_actions_pending). A failed scheduled run is no longer here: it is the service_failed notice of GET /api/services/notices

The trading calendar: confirmed holidays and special sessions from..to (yyyy-MM-dd, default today and a year on, at most 3660 days), every proposed day (from the stored bars, also a proposal next to a confirmed day: replaces names that day's kind) and the next holiday

post.summary: Add a holiday (a weekday) or a special session (sessionFrom/sessionTo HH:mm India time; both left out means 09:15 to 15:30) as confirmed, replacing what the date had. 201 for a new date, 200 when it replaced a row; 400 data.invalid with the field
Read NSE's public holiday list now (best effort, one request). Always 200: succeeded=false with the reason when NSE refused or the list could not be read; add holidays by hand then

put.summary: Confirm a proposed day (idempotent; a proposal next to a confirmed day replaces it); 404 data.calendar_day_not_found when the date has no row or was dismissed, 400 data.invalid for a date that cannot be read

delete.summary: Take a day off the calendar, or dismiss a proposal: the owner's own entry is deleted; a proposal from the stored bars or a day from NSE's list stays as dismissed so it is not proposed again (removing a dismissed day deletes it); a date with a proposal next to a confirmed day dismisses only the proposal (remove again to take the day off). 204; 404 data.calendar_day_not_found

get.summary: One data update with the progress and result of each phase
The latest run over every instrument, the counts (checked, passed, warnings, failed, never checked) and the mean score of the current results, the gate, the window of sessions and the limits in force

The tracked instruments with bars and the current result of their checks: q, status (pass|warning|fail|notChecked), sort (symbol|name|status|score|coverage|barsChecked|missingMinutes|checkedAt, '-' for descending), page, pageSize (max 200)

Every check of one instrument, its missing minutes (at most 500 listed, with the total) and the stored buckets of the window next to the ones recomputed from the 1-minute bars now: differencesOnly, timeframe (5m|10m|15m|30m|1h|1D|1W|1M)
The most recent quality runs, newest first (take 1 to 100, default 20)

The fail-closed gate for the nightly plan: blocked when no finished run exists, the last finished run failed or is older than 3 trading days, or more than Data:Quality:MaxFailedPercent of the checked instruments fail (a running run is no verdict); ok when not blocked and none fails; reasons say why

post.summary: Run the checks in the background (a data job with the step quality): instrumentId limits it to one instrument. 202 with the job; 409 data.job_running while any data job runs, 404 data.instrument_not_found

Fix action: fetch the instrument's missing bars from Dhan again (gap days, including unfillable ones), rebuild its aggregates and check it again, as one data job. 202 with the job; 409 data.job_running, data.dhan_not_connected or data.dhan_not_available; 404 data.instrument_not_found

Fix action: rebuild the instrument's derived timeframes over the window from its 1-minute bars and check it again, as one data job. 202 with the job; 409 data.job_running; 404 data.instrument_not_found

get.summary: The files of the CSV folder: state (pending|loaded|changed - loaded, but size or modified time differ now), size, modified time, the symbol parsed from the name, the instrument it maps to or why not (unknown|ambiguous|invalidName), and rows, firstBar, lastBar, loadedAt and overlapsWith (other loaded files of the instrument covering part of the same time) for loaded files. No file is opened, so hundreds of files list at once. Changed and pending first, then loaded, by name: q (name or symbol), state, page, pageSize (max 200)

post.summary: Dry run of the real reader, row rules and session check over up to 20 files of the folder (names from the listing; anything else is that file's error), nothing written: rows, first and last bar, trading days, repaired and rejected with up to 10 examples, the verdict (pass or the refusal message), the symbol mapping, the first 5 accepted rows and what loading would do to the stored bars (would insert, update, keep existing Dhan bars, unchanged; a spread sample past 1 million lookups per request, flagged sampled). A request reads at most 2 times the per-file limits of Data:Csv and works for at most 60 seconds

Undo the load of one CSV file as a data job: removes the file's csv-source bars of its instrument within the file's recorded first-to-last bar (Dhan bars stay), makes the file pending again, then rebuilds the instrument's aggregates; audited. Values an earlier load overwrote are NOT restored (no history is kept). The removal is by instrument and range: bars of another loaded file in the overlap go too, and the job warns. 202 with the job; 409 data.job_running while any data job runs; 404 data.csv_file_not_found when the file was never loaded

get.summary: The splits and bonus issues, newest ex-date first: status (suggested|applied|ignored), instrumentId, page, pageSize (max 200); pending is the number of suggestions waiting, whatever the filter

post.summary: Add a split (numerator:denominator = old shares : new shares, 1:5 gives a factor of 0.2) or a bonus (bonus shares : shares held, 1:1 gives 0.5) as applied. 201; 400 data.invalid with the field; 404 data.instrument_not_found; 409 data.corporate_action_exists, 409 data.corporate_action_conflicts_same_day (an applied action of the other kind is on that ex-date), 409 data.csv_already_adjusted (the ex-date is on or before csvAdjustedThrough: the loaded CSV files are adjusted at source; send acknowledgeCsvAdjusted=true, in the body or the query, to add it anyway)

put.summary: Confirm a suggestion (an empty body confirms it as it is), change the ex-date, kind, ratio or note, or bring back an ignored action: the result is applied. Fields left out keep their value. 200; 400 data.invalid; 404 data.corporate_action_not_found; 409 data.corporate_action_exists, 409 data.corporate_action_conflicts_same_day, 409 data.csv_already_adjusted (as when adding; acknowledgeCsvAdjusted=true in the body or the query)

post.summary: Decline an action: it stays in the list as ignored (nothing is deleted) and is not suggested again. Idempotent. 200; 404 data.corporate_action_not_found
Look for splits and bonus issues in the stored day bars of every share and ETF now; new candidates become suggested actions, nothing is applied and repeating it finds nothing new. 200 with the counts

Import actions from CSV (header symbol,exDate,kind,numerator,denominator; RELIANCE or NSE:RELIANCE; at most 5,000 lines) sent as the text/csv or text/plain body, or as the first file of a multipart/form-data upload; they are applied. preview=true writes nothing and returns the counts. Unknown symbols are listed, never guessed; duplicates (any status) are skipped; bad lines (also a kind that clashes with an applied one on the same day) are reported and skipped. Lines with an ex-date on or before the date the loaded CSV files reach (adjusted at source) are counted in adjustsCsvTwice and listed in warnings; importing them needs acknowledgeCsvAdjusted=true. 200; 400 data.invalid; 409 data.csv_already_adjusted (with adjustsCsvTwice and instruments)

get.summary: Every registered service (id, name, description, runsAs, enabled, schedule with words, execution settings, parameters with their schema, status healthy|running|failed|paused, lastRun, nextRun, issues, isDefault, revision) and the read-only entries (the per-account sync: readOnly true, manageUrl /accounts)

The trading-day timeline of a date (date yyyy-MM-dd, India time; default today): market hours, the review cutoff, whether it is a trading day and the starts (marks) and up-times (bands) of every enabled service, with the service a run-after entry follows

What the owner should know about the services for the notification bell: service_failed for the latest run of each service with notify on failure when it failed and no retry follows (id service:failed:{serviceId}:{yyyy-MM-dd}: one notice per service per India day, text and time of the latest failure); the next run of the service clears it
One service as the list shows it. 404 services.not_found

The runs and attempts of a service, newest first (page from 1, pageSize 1 to 100, default 25; the latest 200 are shown). trigger scheduled|catch_up|after|manual, status running|succeeded|failed|skipped, dataJobId links the data job a run started. 404 services.not_found

put.summary: Save enabled, schedule (type daily|weekly|after|window|interval|continuous with its fields, times HH:mm India time), retries 0-5, timeoutMinutes 1-240, catchUp, notifyOnFailure and parameters, with the revision read. Checked against all services: 400 services.invalid with issues[] (service, field, message) when anything is wrong, nothing stored; warnings come back with the service. 409 services.revision_changed on a stale revision, 404 services.not_found, 409 services.read_only. Takes effect at the next look of the scheduler, no restart

post.summary: Dry run of a save: the same checks (issues: errors and warnings) and the next three starts, nothing stored. The revision is not looked at. 404 services.not_found, 409 services.read_only

Restore default: writes the definition's default choices (nothing is deleted). Audited. 400 services.invalid if they would break a rule against the other services, 404 services.not_found, 409 services.read_only
Pause: no scheduled, catch-up or run-after starts; past times are not made up for when it is resumed; Run now still works. Audited. 404 services.not_found, 409 services.read_only
Resume a paused service. Audited. 404 services.not_found, 409 services.read_only

Run now (trigger manual), also for a paused service. 202 with the run, which goes on in the background (for the end-of-day run its dataJobId links the data job whose progress /api/data/jobs/{id} shows). Audited. 409 services.already_running when it runs (a skipped run is recorded), 404 services.not_found, 409 services.read_only

get.summary: The holdings that need a decision, evaluated on read by seven rules (below_cost, large_gain, overweight, sector_concentration, long_term_soon, lagging_nifty, not_in_basket): items[{id, rule, severity high|medium|info, accountId, accountName, holdingId, instrumentId, symbol (null for the account-level sector_concentration), title, detail, numbers (the figures behind the item; which are set depends on the rule), suggestions[open|set_alert|add_to_basket|snooze|done], state open|snoozed|done, snoozedUntil}] most important first (severity, then the size of the trigger), and counts {open, snoozed, done, byRule, bySeverity (of the open items; every rule and severity present), unavailable {lagging: holdings held long enough for lagging_nifty that could not be judged because the benchmark has no bars from the first flow or an XIRR is not ok}, noPrice (open holdings without a usable price: no price-based rule fires for them)}. Filters: accountId (404 accounts.not_found when unknown; without it the accounts that count in totals), bucketId (the items about its holdings; weights and sector shares stay shares of the whole account), status open (default) | snoozed | done | all (the counts always cover the whole scope). A snoozed item shows again on its snoozedUntil date. One write is made by this read: a done decision whose condition no longer holds is cleared, so a recurrence shows again

post.summary: Hide an item for 7 days (it shows again on that India date if a rule still produces it): answers {id, state, snoozedUntil, item}. Idempotent; audited. 404 portfolio.not_found for an id that no rule produces now (stale)

Mark an item done: it stays hidden for as long as the condition holds and the decision is cleared when it stops holding (a later recurrence is open again). Answers {id, state, snoozedUntil, item}. Idempotent; audited. 404 portfolio.not_found for an id that no rule produces now (stale)

Take a snooze or done decision back: the item is open again. Answers {id, state open, item (null when no rule produces the id now)}. Idempotent; audited when it changes something; allowed for an item that is gone; 404 portfolio.not_found only for an id that is not the id of any rule's item

get.summary: The thresholds of the Action-center rules in force: values {belowCostPct, belowCostHighPct, gainPct, overweightFloorPct, overweightMultiple, minPositions, concentrationPct, lagPp, lagDays, longTermWindowDays}, the documented defaults, isDefault, updatedBy and updatedAt (null while none are stored)

put.summary: Save the thresholds (all ten required): below cost 1-90 %, high 2-95 % and above below cost, gain 1-1000 %, overweight floor 1-100 %, multiple 1-10, minimum positions 2-50, concentration 5-100 %, lag 1-100 points, lag days 30-3650, long-term window 1-365 days; at most 2 decimals, minPositions/lagDays/longTermWindowDays whole numbers. 400 portfolio.invalid with a field error per problem. The next read of the actions uses them at once. Audited

post.summary: Restore defaults: writes the documented default thresholds. Audited; nothing changes when they are already in force

get.summary: What the owner should know about the portfolio, for the notification bell: price_alert_triggered (warn; one per alert, id portfolio:alert:{alertId}, listed for 7 days after it triggered; carries alertId and instrumentId) and actions_need_decision (info; "N holdings need a decision" when the accounts that count in totals have open Action-center items; id portfolio:actions:{India date}, so it is raised again at most once a day)

The price alerts, newest first: status active | triggered | cancelled | all (default all), page, pageSize (max 100, default 50). Each alert has id, instrumentId, symbol, name, direction (at_or_below | at_or_above), level, note, status, createdAt, triggeredAt and triggerPrice (the last price of the tick that hit the level). The page also carries activeCount of activeLimit (200)

post.summary: Create an active alert: body {instrumentId (an NSE share or ETF of the instrument master that is not retired and that Dhan can quote), direction at_or_below | at_or_above, level (above 0, at most 10,000,000, at most 4 decimals), note (optional, at most 200 characters of plain text)}. Checked on each quotes tick's last price (at_or_below: last <= level; at_or_above: last >= level). 400 portfolio.invalid with field errors, including field level when the condition already holds at the last known price (the holding's last price, else the last stored daily close; unknown: allowed) with the price in the message; 409 portfolio.alert_limit at 200 active alerts. Audited

Cancel an alert. Idempotent: a cancelled alert stays cancelled and a triggered one stays triggered (the answer shows the real status). Audited when it cancels. 404 portfolio.not_found for an unknown id

get.summary: The template of a tradebook file as a CSV download: the canonical header (Date, Symbol, ISIN, Side, Quantity, Price, Exchange, Trade ID, Time, Charges) and two example rows. Other header names are accepted too (any case, punctuation ignored); only date, symbol or ISIN, side, quantity and price are required

post.summary: Read a tradebook against an account and say what importing it would do, storing and changing nothing. Body: multipart/form-data with accountId (an account with the Portfolio role) and file (CSV, UTF-8, at most 10 MB and 20,000 data rows). Returns the file (rows, parsed, skipped by reason, bad rows with line and reason - at most 200 listed, badTotal counts all -, duplicates, alreadyImported, newTrades), the securities - every held or master-listed one and at most 200 unmatched ones; securitiesTotal counts all, unmatchedListed the unmatched listed - (symbol, isin, matched, holdingId, trades, buys, sells, first and last trade date and the rebuild: status ok | unchanged | quantity_mismatch | no_holding | ambiguous, reason, lotsBefore, lotsAfter, handDatedLotsReplaced, syncLotsReplaced, realisedPnl, adjustedFor, q, net, openingQty {before, after}, openCostAfter, brokerCost, costDelta, costNote, digest), notHeld and unmatched {securities, trades} and the overall digest. 400 portfolio.invalid (field file: unreadable, too big, missing columns - with the accepted names -, not UTF-8; accountId); 404 portfolio.not_found (account); 409 portfolio.role_off

Import a tradebook: body multipart/form-data with accountId, file, rebuild (true | false, default true) and digest (required with rebuild: the digest of the preview). Stores the trades the account does not have yet as one batch (a trade id of the file together with the trade date - exchanges number trades per day -, else a hash of the line, is the identity: the same file again stores nothing and makes no batch) and, with rebuild, replaces the lots of every holding whose result is ok by lots built from the real buy and sell dates. Trades of securities not held, of mismatching or ambiguous holdings are stored and not applied. 409 portfolio.preview_stale when holdings, lots, corporate actions or trades changed since the preview (extension report: the fresh preview; nothing applied); 409 portfolio.sync_running while the account's holdings sync runs; 400 portfolio.invalid; 404 portfolio.not_found. Audited with counts only

Add one trade by hand: holdingId, or accountId with symbol and/or isin of an NSE share or ETF of the instrument master; side buy | sell, tradeDate (1990-01-02 to today), tradeTime (optional, India time), quantity (whole, above 0), price (above 0), charges (optional). Validated like a CSV row; identical manual trades are not deduplicated. Changes no lots - rebuild them afterwards. 400 portfolio.invalid with field errors; 404 portfolio.not_found. Audited
Void a trade: it stops counting, is never deleted and can be imported again. Voiding a voided trade is a no-op. Changes no lots - rebuild them afterwards. 404 portfolio.not_found. Audited

get.summary: The imports of tradebook files, newest first: accountId (optional), page, pageSize (max 100, default 50). Each has id, accountId, accountName, fileName, sha256, parsed, imported, duplicates, skipped, bad, status imported | undone, activeTrades, securities, createdBy, createdAt, undoneAt

post.summary: Undo an import: voids its trades (nothing is deleted) and rebuilds from the remaining trades the lots of the affected holdings whose lots came from trades - with none left, one lot of the broker's quantity and cost dated by the first import date, flagged default. LIMITATION: an undo cannot bring back lots the owner dated by hand or a sync added that an earlier rebuild replaced; handDatedLotsReplaced and syncLotsReplaced say how many the rebuild removes (the lots of holdings it rebuilds). Holdings whose lots did not come from trades keep their lots; holdings that cannot be rebuilt (quantity mismatch, ambiguous) keep theirs and are listed in notRebuilt [{symbol, holdingId, reason}] (holdingsNotRebuilt counts them). dryRun=true (default false) changes nothing and returns the same result (dryRun, applied=false) so the confirmation can say what will happen. Undoing twice is a no-op (alreadyUndone). 409 portfolio.sync_running (not for a dry run); 404 portfolio.not_found. Audited with counts only

get.summary: The trades of a holding's security (by ISIN, else symbol), newest first, voided ones included and flagged (voided, voidedAt, voidedBy): page, pageSize (max 200, default 50)

post.summary: Rebuild a holding's lots from its stored trades. dryRun (default true) returns the rebuild block - status, counts of lots replaced, realised profit, adjustments, the broker's quantity against the trades - and changes nothing; dryRun=false replaces the lots when the status is ok (applied) and leaves them for unchanged, quantity_mismatch and ambiguous. A holding without trades is rebuilt into one default-dated lot. 409 portfolio.sync_running (not for a dry run); 404 portfolio.not_found. Audited with counts only

AccountDetail.description:
Everything about one account. Secret values and tokens are never part of it (only set / not set); the client id is masked. ApiKeyIssuedOn and
ApiKeyExpiresOn are the day the Dhan API key was generated and the first day it is no longer valid (12 months). TokenStatus repeats Connection.Status.

AccountEventView.description: One audit entry of an account.

AccountOverrides.description: Per-account replacements for values of the risk profile; null means "use the profile's value".

AccountSummary.description:
One row of the accounts list. Broker is "dhan"; MaskedClientId shows the first four and last two characters; Secrets lists the
secret fields with set / not set; ApiKeyExpiresOn is the first day the Dhan API key is no longer valid; TokenStatus repeats
Connection.Status (for the list's health dot).

ActionCounts.description: What the Action center counts for the scope (before the status filter): items by state, and for the open items by rule (all seven rules, zeros included) and by severity (high, medium, info). `NoPrice` counts open holdings without a usable price (no price-based rule can fire for them).

ActionDecisionView.description: The outcome of a decision: `State``open|snoozed|done`, `SnoozedUntil`, and the item as it is now (null when the id is not produced by a rule now, which only a reopen can still ask about).

ActionItem.description:
One Action-center item. `Id` is stable (`{rule}:{holdingId}`, or `sector_concentration:{accountId}:{12 hex}`) and safe in a URL path. `Rule` is one of `below_cost`, `large_gain`, `overweight`, `sector_concentration`,
`long_term_soon`, `lagging_nifty`, `not_in_basket`; `Severity``high|medium|info`; `HoldingId`, `InstrumentId` and `Symbol` are null for an account-level item (concentration) and `InstrumentId` for a holding that is not in the
master list. `Title` and `Detail` are plain sentences; `Numbers` the figures behind them; `Suggestions` the buttons that make sense (`open|set_alert|add_to_basket|snooze|done`). `State` is `open|snoozed|done`;
`SnoozedUntil` the India date a snoozed item shows again. Severity, text and numbers are recomputed on every read.

ActionList.description: The items of the status asked for, most important first, and the counts of the whole scope.

ActionNumbers.description: The figures that made an item fire; which ones are set depends on the rule, the others are null. below_cost, large_gain: `PnlPct`, `Pnl`, `Invested`, `Value`, `ThresholdPct` (the band reached: 10 or 20 / 25). overweight: `WeightPct` of the account's priced value, `ThresholdPct` (the limit), `Positions` (priced positions of the account), `Value`. sector_concentration: `Sector`, `SectorSharePct` of the account's priced value, `ThresholdPct`, `SectorValue`, `Positions` (in the sector), `LargestSymbol`, `LargestHoldingId` and `LargestValue` of the largest holding in it. long_term_soon: `Lots`, `PnlPct`. lagging_nifty: `HeldDays`, `XirrPct`, `BenchmarkXirrPct`, `GapPp` (holding minus benchmark, negative), `ThresholdPp`. not_in_basket: `Invested`, `Value` (null when unpriced).

ActionThresholds.description: The thresholds of the Action-center rules (ADR 0022, doc 15 §3): percentages are percent numbers (10 = 10 %). The defaults are the ones of the design; the owner edits them in Settings within the fixed ranges below.

ActionThresholdsInput.description: The thresholds to save: every value is required. `MinPositions`, `LagDays` and `LongTermWindowDays` must be whole numbers.

ActionThresholdsView.description: The thresholds in force with the documented defaults; `IsDefault` when they are the defaults; `UpdatedBy`/`UpdatedAt` null while none are stored.

ActionUnavailable.description: Rules that could not be evaluated: `Lagging` holdings held long enough for the lagging-Nifty rule but without a usable benchmark or XIRR.

AddCorporateActionRequest.description:
A corporate action to add by hand (it is applied at once). `exDate``yyyy-MM-dd` (2000-01-01 to a year ahead); `kind` split|bonus; `numerator` and `denominator` whole numbers 1 to 100000
(a split 1:1 changes nothing and is refused); `note` at most 200 characters. `acknowledgeCsvAdjusted` true says the owner knows the loaded CSV files are adjusted up to `csvAdjustedThrough`
and wants an ex-date on or before it anyway (otherwise 409 `data.csv_already_adjusted`).

AddMembersInput.description: Instruments to add (1 to 500; repeats count once) with an optional note stored on each new membership.

AddMembersResult.description:
What an add did (counts of distinct instruments): `added` became members, `alreadyMembers` were members already, `newlyTracked` of the added
ones were not tracked and are now. `memberCount` = members now.

AdjustmentActionView.description: One applied action in the `adjustment` block of a bars read: the ex-date, kind, ratio and the factor of the action itself.

AdjustmentView.description:
What an adjusted read applied: `applied` is the number of applied actions that changed the bars returned (those with an ex-date after the oldest bar), `factor` the cumulative factor of the oldest bar
returned (the strongest; newer bars have a factor closer to 1) and `actions` those actions, oldest ex-date first.

AggregatePhase.description:
The aggregate phase of a data job (ADR 0016 §6): `Done` of `Total` are instruments. `Buckets` counts the bars written (new or changed),
by timeframe; `Full` is true when everything was rebuilt rather than the ranges touched by this job. Part of the API (the job's `aggregate` block).

AggregatesCheck.description: Aggregates against the 1-minute bars: every stored 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1D, 1W and 1M bucket in the window recomputed independently and compared exactly (OHLC, volume, bar count).

AggregatesOverview.description: The derived timeframes: per timeframe, when they were last built and how many instruments have changes that are not aggregated yet.

AutoRefreshView.description: The daily automatic refresh: whether it is on, at what India time, and when it runs next.

BadBar.description: A bar that broke a row rule: its start and what is wrong with it.

BarRow.description: One bar. Times of the day timeframes (`1D 1W 1M`) are India midnight of the first day of the bucket. `bars` counts the 1-minute bars in it; `complete` says none was missing. `source` (1m only): csv · dhan.

BarsOverview.description:
The stored 1-minute bars: instruments with bars, the first bar and the last bar (the "last tick"), how many trading days (by the trading calendar: weekdays without the holidays, with the special sessions) the last bar is behind the last
closed session (`expectedSession`: 15:30 India time, or the end of a special session, has passed), `stale` (behind) and how many instruments are behind or still empty (tracked without bars).

BasketHistory.description: The newest additions and removals of a basket, newest first.

BasketHistoryEntry.description: An addition (`kind` = added, `by` = who added it) or removal (`kind` = removed, `by` = who removed it) of an instrument. Only additions carry a note (the one given when adding); a removal has none.

BasketInput.description: Attributes of a basket (create and replace). Missing colour = the default; missing purpose = trading; blank description = none.

BasketMemberView.description:
One stay of an instrument in a basket: `validFrom` = when it was added, `validTo` = when it was removed (null while it is a member),
`position` = place among the members (0 first), `addedBy` = the owner's address.
In a system (portfolio) basket a member is the instrument of the bucket's holdings: `id` = the (first) holding, `validFrom` = when the holding was first seen,
`addedBy` = "portfolio", `quantity` = units held (summed over the bucket's holdings of it) and `accountName` = the account(s) holding it; both are null in a manual basket.

BasketMembers.description:
The members of a basket, in their order. `asOf` is null for the current members, otherwise the India date they are as of (members at the end of that
day; removed ones show their `validTo`). `total` counts the items.

BasketOrderInput.description: Every active basket exactly once, in the wanted order.

BasketView.description:
A basket. `purpose`: trading · long_term · watch. `position` = place among the active baskets (0 first; the system baskets count on their own, in their group).
`memberCount` = instruments in it now. `archivedAt` is null for an active basket (archived ones are only listed on request).
`kind`: manual (the owner's) · portfolio (an account's portfolio bucket, ADR 0014); `system` = true for the latter: read-only, never archived, its members are the
bucket's current holdings. `accountId`/`accountName` are set for the default bucket of an account.

BenchmarkInput.description: Sets the benchmark: the id of a master-list index.

BenchmarkView.description: The benchmark in force (all null when the master list has no such index yet). `IsDefault`: the owner has not chosen one, Nifty 50 applies.

BrokerIdView.description: The id a broker uses for the instrument (Dhan: security id + exchange segment).

BucketInput.description: A new custom bucket. The name has 1 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, '_' or '-' and is unique ignoring case.

BucketView.description:
One bucket to pick from. IsAccountDefault is true for the automatic default bucket of an account that has the Portfolio role
(AccountId and AccountName name that account); custom buckets have neither.

CalendarDayView.description:
A date of the trading calendar (ADR 0017 §1). `kind`: holiday · special. A special session has `sessionFrom` and `sessionTo` (`HH:mm`, India time,
the end exclusive) and `minutes` (its length, the 1-minute bars a complete session has); a holiday has none of the three. `source`: manual · observed · nse.
`status`: confirmed · proposed (`dismissed` days are not listed). `replaces`: set only on a proposal that lies next to a confirmed day (a session seen on a listed
holiday, say) and names that day's kind: the confirmed day stays in force until the owner confirms the proposal (which replaces it) or dismisses it.

CalendarRefreshResult.description:
The answer of a refresh from NSE's public holiday list. It never fails the request: `succeeded` false means the list could not be fetched or read (`message` says why,
nothing changed). Otherwise the counts of the list's holidays that were added, updated, already known and left out (weekends, dates out of range, days the owner
decided or the stored bars contradict).

CalendarView.description:
The trading calendar. `days`: the confirmed holidays and special sessions from `from` to `to` (India dates, both included; default today and a
year on), by date. `proposals`: every proposed day, whatever its date, waiting for Confirm or Dismiss (including proposals that lie next to a confirmed day, marked `replaces`). `nextHoliday`: the first confirmed holiday
today or later (null when none is known).

CompletenessCheck.description:
Completeness: the 1-minute bars the trading calendar expects in the window against the ones stored. `missingPercent` is of the expected minutes; `unfillableMinutes` are missing
minutes of sessions a refetch could not fill (a halt, a circuit-locked day): they are a warning, never a failure.

ConnectStartView.description: Where to send the owner's browser to sign in at Dhan (same tab): Dhan's consent login page. The sign-in must come back before ExpiresAt.

ConnectionInput.description: New connection details of an account. Leave ClientId out to keep the current client id.

ConnectionView.description:
The account's connection to Dhan. Status is "not_connected", "connected", "expired" (the expiry has passed — derived when read,
no broker call needed). ExpiresAt is when the token stops working (as Dhan states, otherwise 24 hours after sign-in).
BrokerUserName and BrokerUserId (masked like the client id) are what Dhan reported for the token. LastError is a short safe text (at most
Dhan's error code). The token itself is never returned.

CorporateActionPage.description: A page of corporate actions, newest ex-date first. `pending` is the number of suggestions waiting for a decision over all instruments, whatever the filter.

CorporateActionView.description:
A split or bonus issue of an instrument (ADR 0017 §5). `kind`: split · bonus. `numerator:denominator` (`ratio`): for a split old shares : new shares (1:5 is one share into five), for a bonus
bonus shares : shares held (1:1 is one bonus share for each held). `factor` is the price multiplier for the bars before `exDate` (a 1:5 split 0.2, a 1:1 bonus 0.5). `status`: suggested
(found by the detection, changes nothing yet) · applied (adjusted reads use it) · ignored (declined, kept so it is not suggested again). `source`: manual · detected · csv.
`decidedAt` and `decidedBy` are set once the owner decided (not while suggested). `csvAdjustedThrough`: the date the instrument's loaded CSV files reach (their last bar, in India time; null when
none is loaded). Those files are already adjusted at source, so an action with an ex-date on or before it would adjust their prices twice.

CreateAccountInput.description:
A new Dhan account. ClientId and Secrets (API key and secret) are required. ApiKeyIssuedOn is the day the API key was generated
(default today, India time).

CsvFileCounts.description: The files by state over the whole folder (not narrowed by `state`, but by `q`), and how many cannot be loaded (`unmapped`: unknown, ambiguous or invalid name).

CsvFilePage.description: A page of the folder's files: changed and pending first, then loaded, by name; `total` is the number after the filters.

CsvFilePreview.description:
The dry run of the real reader over one file, nothing written. `verdict`: pass · refused · error (see `message`). `rows` are the data rows, `accepted` the ones that would be stored (`repaired` among them),
`rejected` the others, counted by reason in `rejections` with up to 10 `examples` (line numbers and reasons, never row values). `tradingDays` counts the distinct India dates of the accepted bars.
`wouldLoad`: passes and maps to exactly one instrument. `firstRows`: the first 5 accepted bars. `comparison` is null when the file does not pass or does not map.

CsvFileRow.description:
One file of the CSV folder. `state`: pending · loaded · changed (loaded, but size or modified time differ now). `symbol` is parsed from the name (null for an invalid name),
`mapping`: mapped · unknown · ambiguous · invalidName, `instrument` is set when mapped. `rows`, `firstBar`, `lastBar` (null for a file loaded before the range was recorded) and
`loadedAt` are set for loaded and changed files. `overlapsWith` (loaded and changed files; null for pending ones): the names of the other loaded files of the same instrument that cover part
of the same time — undoing either removes the instrument's CSV bars in the overlap, whichever file wrote them.

CsvInstrumentRef.description: The instrument a file maps to: its id and canonical symbol (`NSE:ABB`).

CsvOverview.description: The CSV folder: the files that match `<SYMBOL>_1m.csv[.gz]`, how many are loaded (unchanged since they were loaded) or pending, the rows loaded so far and when the last file was loaded.

CsvPhase.description:
The CSV phase of a data job (ADR 0016 §4): `Done` of `Total` are files. Rows are counted over all files read in this job. Part of the API
(the job's `csv` block) and stored with the job. `BarsRemoved` is set only by the job that undoes the load of one file (ADR 0017 §6): the CSV bars it removed (null for every other job).

CsvPreviewBar.description: An accepted bar, as the load would store it (after repair), with its start in India time.

CsvPreviewComparison.description:
What loading the file would do to the stored bars of its instrument, in bars: `wouldInsert` (minute not stored yet), `wouldUpdate` (a CSV bar of that minute with other values),
`keepExistingDhan` (a Dhan bar of that minute is kept: CSV never overwrites Dhan) and `unchanged` (same values). Counted over `comparedRows` accepted rows; when the file has more
accepted rows than the request may compare (`sampled`), a spread sample of whole batches is compared and the counts are of that sample, not scaled.

CsvPreviewResult.description: The previews in the order the files were asked for; `rowsRead` and `comparedRows` are the totals of the request (its limits are in the summary of the endpoint).

DataAccountView.description: The primary Data account. `status`: connected · expired · notConnected.

DataInstrumentRow.description:
An instrument's coverage. `source`: csv · dhan · mixed (null without bars). `status`: current · behind · empty (tracked, no bars).
`daysBehind` counts trading days (null without bars). `openGaps`: sessions in the last weeks with missing bars that a refetch may still add.

DataJobView.description:
One data job (a run of the pipeline, ADR 0016). `status`: running · succeeded · failed · skipped (a scheduled run that did not start; `error` says why). `trigger`: manual · daily (the scheduled end-of-day run).
`refetchGaps`: the Dhan phase also retried the gaps it had given up on. `currentPhase` (while running): csv · dhan · aggregate · quality. `instrumentId` is set when the job is
about one instrument (a fix action of the Data quality screen). `csvFiles`: the files the CSV step was asked to load (null: every file of the folder). `undoCsvFile`: the file whose load this job undoes
(its `csv` block then reports `barsRemoved` and the message "CSV load of … undone, N bars removed"; the `aggregate` block rebuilds the instrument). `quality` is the data quality phase, present only when the job asked for the step (`runId` names its quality run).
Each phase block has `status` (notRequested · pending · running · succeeded · skipped · failed), `done` of `total` (files, instruments,
instruments), `message` and `code` (why it was skipped or failed) and its counts.

DataNotice.description:
Something about the data pipeline the owner should know, derived from the stored state like the account notices of the bell. `id` includes the situation (a new failed
run or a changed number of open gaps is a new notice, hence unread again). `kind`: data_gaps_open · data_quality_failed (instruments fail the data quality checks: warn within the allowed share, error when the gate blocks the nightly plan) · data_corporate_actions_pending (suggested splits or bonus issues wait for a decision; warn). `severity`: error · warn.

DataRoleInput.description: Switch the Data role. Kind ("primary" or "standby") is required when Enabled is true.

DataRoleView.description: Data role of an account: on/off and which kind.

DetectionResult.description: What a detection run did: `instruments` looked at, `candidates` found, `suggested` new suggestions stored (the others were known already, ignored ones included) and `pending` suggestions now waiting.

DhanOverview.description:
The Dhan Data API phase: the primary Data account (null when there is none), whether a fetch can run now (`canFetch`) and, when not, why
(`reason` in words, `reasonCode` data.dhan_not_available · data.dhan_not_connected), the settings, and the last successful fetch (time and bars added).

DhanPhase.description:
The Dhan phase of a data job (ADR 0016 §2, §7): `Done` of `Total` are instruments. `Bars` are the 1-minute bars Dhan returned;
`Rejected` are bars that did not lie on an IST minute inside a session or broke the row rules; `OverlapCompared` and
`OverlapMismatched` compare the overlap with the bars already stored (tolerance 0.05 %). `GapsFound` counts the instrument-sessions with missing bars
this phase planned to refetch or found still incomplete, `GapsFilled` those that now have all their bars and `GapsUnfillable` those a refetch added nothing to
(ADR 0017 §3). Part of the API (the job's `dhan` block).

DhanRedirectView.description: The redirect URL to register with the Dhan app, exactly as shown: `{PublicBaseUrl}/api/brokers/dhan/callback`.

Drawdown.description:
The largest peak-to-trough fall of a NAV series: `Pct` is a percent number (12.5 means it fell 12.5 %) from the peak on `From` to the low on `To`. A series that never falls (flat or rising)
gives 0 and no dates.

EodOverview.description:
The scheduled end-of-day run (ADR 0017 §2) as set on the Services screen (ADR 0018): `enabled` (the service is not paused), `timeIst` (`HH:mm`, India time; empty when the schedule has no time of its own),
`nextRunAt` (the next scheduled start; null when paused or none ahead), `lastRun` (the latest automatic data job, null before the first) and `scheduleWords` (the schedule in words).

EodRunView.description:
An automatic (scheduled) run as the Data screen shows it. `status`: running · succeeded · failed · skipped; `message` is the reason a run failed or was skipped
(for example the Data account was not connected). `trigger` is always `daily` here.

ExecutionView.description: How a service is run: retries (0–5 after a failed attempt), the timeout of an attempt in minutes (1–240), whether a missed run is made up for when the application starts, and whether a failure raises a notice in the bell.

FacetCount.description: A filter value and how many active instruments have it.

FirstImportInput.description:
Optional per-holding dates for the first import that happens when the portfolio settings are saved (ADR 0013). Without rows, every holding Dhan lists is
imported dated with the first import date (flagged default-date); a row (key from `holdings/preview`, acquisition date) overrides the date of its holding.
At most 5000 rows. Used only when the account is connected to Dhan and has no holdings yet.

FirstImportView.description:
What a first import did. Status: "imported" (the holdings were created; the counts say how many), "skipped" (the account already has holdings, nothing was
imported), "deferred" (the account is not connected to Dhan, or the Portfolio role is off: the first sync imports every holding, dated FirstImportDate) or
"failed" (the settings were saved but the import was not: ErrorCode is `portfolio.import_failed`, Cause the code of the reason, for example
`portfolio.not_connected`, `portfolio.sync_running`; Message says what to do; save again or press Sync now to retry). Imported counts holdings created, DefaultDated those
among them dated by the first import date, AlreadyImported keys the account had already, Unknown keys Dhan no longer lists. Redated counts the lots that
followed a changed first import date (imported lots still on the default date; they stay flagged as such), RedateSkipped the ones that could not follow
because they were closed before the new date; both are 0 when the date did not change or the account has no holdings (ADR 0015).

FreshnessCheck.description: Freshness against the trading calendar: the last bar and the last closed session; `daysBehind` counts trading days.

GapRow.description:
A session of an instrument with missing 1-minute bars (ADR 0017 §3). `date` is the India date, `expected` the bars a complete session has (from the trading
calendar), `found` what is stored, `attempts` how often a refetch was made. `status`: open · filled · unfillable (a refetch added nothing).
`lastAttemptAt` is the latest refetch (null before the first), `detectedAt` when the gap was found.

GapsOverview.description:
How many instrument-sessions are in each state (the Dhan phase's gap table): `open` (missing bars a refetch may still add), `unfillable` (a refetch added
nothing), `filled`; `lastDetectedAt` is when a gap was last found (null while there never was one).

GroupPart.description: The value of the holdings of a group that fall in one part of the second dimension (an account for sectors, a sector for accounts); the parts sum to the group's value.

HistoryBenchmark.description:
The benchmark of a history. `State` is `ok` (the benchmark lines are filled) or `unavailable` with the `Reason` in words. `Symbol` is the canonical symbol and `Name` the display name of the index (null when the master list has
no such index). `Tracked`: tracking is on; `HasBars`: 1-minute bars are stored (the day bars follow when the aggregates are built). A screen offers "Track the benchmark" when it is unavailable and not tracked.
`AsOf` is the date of the last index close the benchmark lines were valued at (null when unavailable): the index has no live quote, so the benchmark lines end there and a live point of today (portfolio at today's prices) has no benchmark value.

HistoryCoverage.description:
How much of the open holdings the history covers: `Holdings` open holdings, `Covered` of them have stored day bars, `Unpriced` have none (not tracked, not in the instrument master, or bars not fetched yet:
they are left out and never valued at zero). `LateStart` counts covered holdings whose bars begin after their earliest lot, so part of their history is missing.

HistoryPoint.description:
One day of the portfolio history (rupees; `Nav` and `BenchmarkNav` start at 100). `Value` is what the lots held that day were worth at the day's close (adjusted prices), `Invested` what
they cost. `BenchmarkValue` is the same cash flows put into the benchmark index; it and `BenchmarkNav` are null when the benchmark has no history for the series.

HoldingGroup.description:
One group. Key is the account id, bucket id, sector name or basket id, or `~none` for the sector "Unclassified" and the basket "No basket". Holdings counts every holding of the group in the scope;
Unpriced the open ones without a usable price. DayChangeExcluded counts the open holdings left out of the day change. Parts is set only when the request had a `stackBy`.

HoldingGroupTotal.description: The scope's totals, computed once over every holding of the scope (for basket groupings this is not the sum of the groups). WeightPct is 100 when the scope has a value.

HoldingGroups.description:
The groups of the scope. By is `account`, `bucket`, `sector` or `basket`; Additive is false for baskets (a holding is in every basket that contains it, so the groups overlap). StackBy is the second dimension of the
parts, when asked for. At most 200 groups are returned.

HoldingLots.description: The lots of a holding, open lots first (oldest first), then closed ones.

HoldingPage.description: One page of holdings (Total counts all matches).

HoldingRebuildResult.description: The rebuild of one holding's lots: with `DryRun` only what it would do; otherwise `Applied` says whether the lots were replaced (only an `ok` rebuild is).

HoldingRow.description:
One holding. Status is "open" or "closed". Mapped is false when the holding is not in the instrument master (InstrumentId and CanonicalSymbol are
then null). LotCount counts open lots; EarliestAcquiredOn is the oldest open lot's date; UsesDefaultDate is true when any open lot has the
import's default date. Returns cover all lots (closed lots add to RealisedPnl and to the XIRR).
PreviousClose is the previous session's close as the last quote reported it (null until a quote gave one). DayChange (rupees) and DayChangePct (percent number) are
against it, for an open, priced holding with a previous close; otherwise both are null and the holding is left out of the summary's day change. PriceAt is the time of
LastPrice (the same instant as LastPriceAt) and PriceSource says where the price came from: "sync" (the holdings list at the last sync) or "quote" (a market quote).

HoldingsSummary.description:
Totals over the holdings of the filter (all accounts that count in totals, one account, one bucket). DefaultDateLots counts open lots that
still have the import's default date. UnpricedCount counts open holdings without a usable price: they are left out of Returns (invested, value, P&L, XIRR). ValuationDate is the day the values are as of (today in India).
DayChange (rupees) is the sum of the day changes of the included open holdings and DayChangePct (percent number) is that sum over the sum of qty x previous close of the same holdings; both are null when no
holding is included. DayChangeExcluded counts the open holdings left out (no previous close or no usable price). PricesAsOf holds the oldest and the newest price time of the open priced holdings.
BenchmarkXirr (percent number) is the XIRR of the same cash flows put into the benchmark index (Nifty 50 by default, ADR 0020 §2), Alpha the portfolio's XIRR minus it in percentage points; BenchmarkState is "ok", "unavailable" (the index has no history
from the first cash flow: track it and run Update data), "insufficient" (the same reasons as for XIRR) or "n_m" (beyond ±1,000 %). BenchmarkXirr and Alpha are null unless their rates are meaningful (Alpha also needs the portfolio's XirrState "ok").
BenchmarkAsOf is the date of the index close the benchmark was valued at: the index has no live quote, so on a trading day before its bar is fetched it is the previous close while the portfolio is valued at today's prices. AlphaBasis says which
it is when Alpha is set: "last_close" (portfolio and index are both as of their last close) or "live_vs_last_close" (the portfolio at prices of a later trading day than the index close, so the alpha includes the day's move of the portfolio only).

ImportCorporateActionsResult.description:
The outcome of a CSV import (or its preview). `lines`: data lines read; `importable`: new valid actions; `imported`: written (0 for a preview); `duplicates`: lines that repeat an action
that exists (any status) or an earlier line; `invalid`: lines with a problem (the first 50 in `errors`, among them lines that clash with an applied action of the other kind on the same day);
`unknownSymbols`: symbols that match no listed instrument (never guessed). `adjustsCsvTwice`: how many of the importable lines have an ex-date on or before the date their instrument's loaded
CSV files reach, listed in `warnings` (the first 50); an import (not a preview) with such lines needs `acknowledgeCsvAdjusted=true`, else 409 `data.csv_already_adjusted`.

ImportLineError.description: A line of an imported text that could not be used, with the reason (no free text from the file is repeated).

ImportLineWarning.description:
A valid line whose ex-date is on or before the date the instrument's loaded CSV files reach (`csvAdjustedThrough`): importing it would adjust those already adjusted prices twice.
`symbol` is the canonical symbol (`NSE:ABB`).

ImportPreview.description: What Dhan holds for the account, nothing saved. DefaultDate is the account's first import date (2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another).

ImportRowInput.description: One holding to import (a key from the preview). AcquiredOn left out means "use the first import date" (the lot is then flagged).

InstrumentBars.description:
The latest bars of an instrument and timeframe, newest first. `adjustment` is set only when the read asked for adjusted prices (`adjusted=true`): the bars then have the open, high, low and close multiplied by
the cumulative factor of the corporate actions applied after their date, rounded to 4 decimals, and the volume divided by it; the block says which actions and what factor (see AdjustmentView).

InstrumentBasketView.description: A basket that holds an instrument now; `since` = when it was added.

InstrumentDetail.description: Everything the master list knows about an instrument.

InstrumentPage.description: One page of search results (`total` counts all matches).

InstrumentSummary.description: A row of the master list. `type`: share · etf · index · future.

LastDataJobs.description: The latest job in which each phase ran to an end (null when none did yet).

LongTermLot.description: A profitable open lot that turns 12 months old soon (the `long_term_soon` rule): `LongTermOn` is the date it is 12 months old, `DaysLeft` the days until then, `GainPct` its unrealised gain in percent (null for a lot that cost nothing, for example bonus shares: the gain is then the whole value and has no percentage).

LotDateInput.description: Sets the acquisition date of a lot (between 1990-01-01 and today, India).

LotRow.description:
A lot of a holding with its own figures: Invested is its cost, Value is its value now (open) or its sale proceeds (closed), Pnl the difference.
Status is "open" or "closed"; Source "import", "added" or "manual". Estimated: the sale price is the last price a sync saw.

ManualTradeInput.description:
A trade typed in by the owner: for a holding (`HoldingId`) or for a security of an account (`AccountId` and `Symbol` and/or `Isin`, which must be an NSE share or ETF of the master list). `Side` buy or sell, the date not in the
future, `Quantity` a whole number above 0, `Price` above 0, `Charges` optional (0).

MembersOrderInput.description: Every member of the basket exactly once, in the wanted order.

MissingMinute.description: A missing minute: the India date and the minute (`HH:mm`).

OfficialDailyCheck.description: The comparison of the derived daily bar with the broker's official daily candle: not available until official daily candles are fetched.

OpeningQtyView.description: The quantity the lots count as opening (the shares the trades do not explain): now, and after the rebuild. Null where it cannot be told (no holding, or a quantity that is not whole after a split or bonus).

ParameterView.description: A parameter of a service with its schema: `kind` integer · number · boolean, the bounds of a number, the current value and the default.

PortfolioHistory.description:
The value history of a scope (all accounts that count in totals, one account, one bucket). `Points` are in date order at `Resolution` (`day`, `week` or `month`: the last trading day of the period); `Value` is what the
lots held that day were worth at that day's close (adjusted for splits and bonuses), `Invested` what they cost, `BenchmarkValue` the same cash flows in the benchmark index, `Nav` and `BenchmarkNav` unit values starting at 100
that cash flows do not move. `Coverage` says how many open holdings have price history; `Partial` is true when anything is left out (holdings without bars, history that starts late). `MaxDrawdown` / `BenchmarkMaxDrawdown`: the largest
fall of the NAV measured within the requested range (`Pct` 12.5 = fell 12.5 %; the peak must lie inside the range too) between the peak on `From` and the low on `To`, daily, whatever the resolution; `RangeFrom` and `RangeTo` are the first and
the last day of that range as returned (null when there is no point). `FirstDate` is the first day of the whole history (before the range is cut). `LastPriceAt` is set when the last point is today's live one: the time of the newest price in it.

PortfolioInput.description: The portfolio configuration to change. Every field that is left out (null) keeps the account's current value, on update. DefaultBucket: the name of the bucket imports go to — a custom bucket's name; an empty string "" (or the name of the account's own "{account name} · Portfolio" bucket) selects the account's own default bucket; null or omitted keeps the current choice. IncludeInTotals: true or false; null keeps it. At account creation, omitted means the account's own bucket and true. The automatic holdings refresh: RefreshMode "off" or "daily"; RefreshDailyTimeIst "HH:mm" (India time); left out keeps the current value (a new account: off, 16:00). FirstImportDate (not in the future, not before 1990-01-01) is the date the first import gives holdings without a date of their own. FirstImport is honoured only when updating the portfolio settings of an account (it is ignored at account creation): see FirstImportInput.

PortfolioNotice.description: One notice of the Portfolio module for the top-bar bell. `Kind` is `price_alert_triggered` (`Severity` warn; `AlertId` and `InstrumentId` set) or `actions_need_decision` (info). `Id` is stable, so the bell keeps what was read by id.

PortfolioSaved.description: The answer of saving the portfolio settings: the account as saved and what the first import did (always present; see FirstImportView).

PortfolioSettingsView.description:
Portfolio configuration. DefaultBucket is the name of the bucket imports go to (the account's own default bucket unless a custom bucket was chosen);
AutoBucketName is the name of the account's own default bucket ("{account name} · Portfolio") — the one that exists, or, while the account has none yet,
the name it would get now (with a numeric suffix when the plain name is taken); it is chosen for real when the role is switched on.
The holdings refresh by themselves according to RefreshMode: "off" (default) or "daily" (once a day from RefreshDailyTimeIst, "HH:mm" India time, default 16:00;
the time is kept while the mode is off). FirstImportDate is the date holdings get when they are imported for the first time without a date of their own
(2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another). HasHoldings is true once the account has any holding; the first import has happened then and
FirstImportDate no longer affects existing holdings (ADR 0013).

PortfolioTrackResult.description: What a track action did. `Requested` distinct master-list instruments were asked to be tracked, `Added` of them are newly tracked (or tracked again), `AlreadyTracked` were; `NotInMaster` open holdings in scope are not in the instrument master (nothing to track), `Retired` instruments are no longer listed and were skipped. `TotalTracked` is the number tracked now. No job is started: `Hint` says the next Update data builds the bars.

PreviewCsvFilesRequest.description: The files to preview: names from the folder listing, at most int PreviewCsvFilesHandler.MaxFiles.

PreviewRow.description:
A holding Dhan reports, for the first import in the portfolio settings. Key identifies it in the import request (the ISIN, otherwise "securityId:EXCHANGE").
Mapped is false when it is not in the instrument master. AlreadyImported: the account has the holding (open) already.
SuggestedDate is the date to pre-fill: the first import date, or the oldest lot's date of an already imported holding.

PriceAlertInput.description: A new price alert: the master-list share or ETF, `Direction``at_or_below|at_or_above`, the `Level` in rupees (above 0, at most 10,000,000, at most 4 decimals) and an optional plain-text `Note` of at most 200 characters.

PriceAlertPage.description: One page of alerts, newest first (`Total` counts all matches). `ActiveCount` of `ActiveLimit` alerts are active, whatever the filter.

PriceAlertView.description:
A price alert. `Status` is `active`, `triggered` (with `TriggeredAt` and `TriggerPrice`, the last price of the tick that hit the level) or `cancelled`. It is checked on the last price of each quotes tick only (every 5 minutes while the market
is open): a spike between two ticks is not seen.

PricesAsOf.description: The oldest and the newest time of the prices of the open holdings (null when none has a priced time).
